title: Byte-slice equality whose trace depends on the length alone
contract_header:
use eq = "yhus24dbjyhcm7qaoeef2ryezipmeszgofacitqnywda6uqpypdq"  // hash_eq_ct_spec.ode

fn ct_bytes_eq(a: n bytes, b: n bytes, n: number)
    returns eq.ct_bytes_eq(a, b)
    trace depends on n
    stack 0
task_summary: Implement and verify byte-slice equality `ct_bytes_eq`: it returns 1 when the two runs of `n` bytes are the same and 0 otherwise, and its execution trace may depend on the length `n` alone (never on the bytes of `a` or `b`).
